correctness.rationale: Normalized Gaussian STFT and area convention yield known exact Hermite eigenvalues. Integration by parts gives a sign-exact adjacent spectral difference, yielding all maximizers and switch degeneracies; differentiating at each tie gives a strictly positive cusp jump. Uniform Stirling expansion for bounded index offset verifies the full oscillatory \(O(s^{-2})\) bracket remainder, and monotone unbounded logarithmic mean verifies all cluster values. The standalone checker provides 1320 numeric corroborations, not an infinite certification.

originality.rationale: The exact Gaussian annulus eigenintegrals are known (Knutsen 2019); the inspected original same-object ring proof identifies only two candidate modes and an undetermined next-order norm error. The exact global log-mean mode selection, all cusp locations/slopes, and explicit oscillatory correction are not implied by the inspected statements; no direct duplicate was found in closely related operator sources. Historical priority remains provisional, particularly through Poisson-uniform-mixture literature.
residual_risks: The exact modal index might already be named as a theorem about uniformly mixed Poisson distributions under different notation.
The full historical corpus of radial Fock Toeplitz and incomplete-gamma mode theorems has not been exhaustively checked.
The proposed mode rule relies on the known spectral diagonalization and its independent priority is not claimed.

value.rationale: The Gaussian fixed-area annulus is an established canonical time-frequency concentration benchmark. The complete mode staircase and eigenspace classification identify optimal concentrating signals for all annuli, cusp sizes measure sensitivity to radius, and the explicit phase-dependent second term demonstrates the absence of a constant next-order norm coefficient. These are motivated exact structural and asymptotic facts that improve the specifically identified two-candidate/\(O(R^{-3})\) results, without claiming new general radial diagonalization.
